resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1961. Rex's page quotes annual reports that bought materials in 1959 and report construction in 1960, with painting in 1961. The story uses 1961 as the build year and says the annual reports point to 1960.
The register and firelookout.com say last staffed in 2006. Rex's page says staffing ended in 2007, when the lookout was declared unsafe. The story reports both years.

notes_for_editor: The brief's built year (1961) and removal year (2010) match the register and firelookout.com. The annual-report sequence (materials 1959, construction 1960) suggests the build may be 1960, so the editor may want to choose between 1960 and 1961 for the infobox. The staffing end is 2006 in two sources and 2007 in one. No source describes what remains at the site today, and no access information was found, so access is omitted. Search results for the 2010 burning were unrelated (a California fire of the same name) and were not used.
